body.name: M_pub
body.def: \(\mathfrak M_{p,m}^{\mathrm{pub}}\) is the shared-order LiMVAM class with centered finite-second-moment product disturbances within each view, strictly positive within-view disturbance variances, and unrestricted cross-view disturbance covariance.
body.role: This note's deliberately weakened unrestricted-cross-view comparison layer; it is not the full assumption class of the cited LiMVAM identification theorem.
